summary: IEEE-library form of counter relay with manual reset: a manually reset counter relay records qualifying events and retains a count until the documented reset action.
description: This reference locates counter relay with manual reset in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented counter relays family. A manually reset counter relay records qualifying events and retains a count until the documented reset action. Event input, count condition and reset control should be identifiable on the drawing. The public library uses HCR1CNM for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
